sloka: अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम् ।पावनः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन ।। ७.८२.९ ॥
transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṁ vākyaṁ tava rāma śubhākṣaram ।pāvanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ tvameva raghunandana ।। 7.82.9 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, your words are indeed very wonderful and auspicious, for you alone, O delight of the Raghus, are the purifier of all beings.
